main_measure.name: t of mean of (forecast/10) x (24-bar forward return minus coin's normal 24-bar drift), grid cases with forecast > 0
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 (with upper-minus-lower half difference > 0); reject if t <= -2; else inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean excess 24-bar forward return, upper half minus lower half at median forecast

decided_by: The main measure's t is 2 or more and the upper-half minus lower-half difference is positive.
reading: Cases are bars at positions 0, 24, 48, ... of each window with forecast > 0 and a forward return inside the window; the coin's normal drift is the mean 24-bar return over all grid bars of all its windows; the upper half is forecast > median and the lower half forecast <= median; the plan's 200-case minimum, when not reached, gives 'not observable' as the workflow requires.
